result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is visually cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated at the right edge of the screen, with no visual affordance (like a partial card peek or scroll indicator) clearly suggesting horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Show a more deliberate partial peek of the third card to signal horizontal scrolling, or add a visible scroll indicator. Ensure the restaurant name is not cut off mid-word in a way that looks broken.

issues.description: The notification dot (red dot) in the top-right corner appears to be floating loosely over a gray circle button without clear context of what it represents, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the notification badge is clearly associated with an icon (e.g., a bell or cart icon) inside the button to make its purpose obvious.
